acceptedAnswer.text: Environmentally conscious construction, also known as green building, focuses on minimizing a project's environmental impact throughout its lifecycle. This includes selecting sustainable materials, optimizing energy efficiency, conserving water, reducing waste, and improving indoor air quality. For Hometelligent Inc., this often involves strategic planning to incorporate locally sourced materials available in the Alameda and Berkeley areas, reducing transportation emissions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Environmentally conscious construction minimizes a project's environmental impact by using sustainable materials, optimizing energy efficiency, and reducing waste.
